alex_w: Heads-up — hitting kernel-selection churn in the canary for seq=1024 on openlm-small. Telemetry shows per-token switch from attn_fast -> attn_fallback mid-request, which correlates with a large KV-cache hit for a long prefix. not sure why pick flips after token 20.
sam_h: Ugh. Do you have the pick trace? Try enabling REDWOOD_RT_PICK_TRACE=1 and REDWOOD_RT_DEBUG=kernel_pick, then repro and paste the trace. Also note if batching changed (batch 1->2) mid-run.
jess_m: KV cache behavior can change effective seqlen; if prefix cached we send shorter live seqlen and some heuristics recompute kernel choice. Might be the heuristic threshold crossing at 512 vs 1024.
perf-bot: small trace excerpt (from client):
```
[pick] ts=1953123456 token=1 model=openlm-small arch=ampere seq_len=1024 batch=4 cached_prefix=512 chosen=attn_fast reason=tile_size_ok hw_intrinsics=simd
[pick] ts=1953123460 token=21 model=openlm-small arch=ampere seq_len=1024 batch=4 cached_prefix=1024 chosen=attn_fallback reason=kv_cache_mismatch vectorized_unavailable
[pick] reason_code=KV_PREFETCH_MISALIGN fallback_count=1 probe_id=exp-2026-03-17-1
```
alex_w: That fallback_count=1 lines up. Repro steps: single client, prompt ~1.5k tokens, batch=4, sometimes backend autoscaler swapped a GPU and kernel table got reloaded which may unset patchable intrinsics.
sam_h: Two immediate actions: 1) add reason_code in telemetry (KV_PREFETCH_MISALIGN, TILE_TOO_SMALL, HW_INTRINSIC_MISS, SEQ_BUCKET_SWITCH), 2) log the active autotune profile id with every pick (`autotune_profile=...`). Also add counter for mid-request pick changes.
jess_m: Agreed. Also propose tuning sequence buckets to avoid borderline switches: set SEQ_BUCKETS=[64,128,256,512,768,1024] for this model. Toggle via env `REDWOOD_AUTOTUNE_SEQ_BUCKETS=1` for canary.
perf-bot: proposed logging patch diff (informal):
```
- pick_log: {model, chosen_kernel}
+ pick_log: {model, chosen_kernel, reason_code, autotune_profile, probe_id, fallback_count, kv_cache_prefetch_hits}
```
alex_w: Will try the env flags now. If we still see mid-request flips we should force pin kernel for that run to isolate KV behavior.
sam_h: For repro locally: `rdw-bench --model openlm-small --seq 1024 --batch 4 --prompt-file long_prompt.txt --trace-pick --env REDWOOD_RT_PICK_TRACE=1` — that spits out pick traces to stdout.
jess_m: If this is causing p95 regressions let's file a perf bug and add `sla-incident` tag. I saw p95 jump ~18% in last Canary window.
perf-bot: Note: added automated alert rule draft — trigger if mid_request_pick_changes > 5 per minute OR p95_latency_increase > 10% over baseline.
alex_w: Thanks — i'll run the bench and paste full trace. If we can add `reason_code` quickly, we can correlate cause across customers. :thumbsup:
